# Pesher Psalms Column 1 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 4QpPs (4Q171), Col. 1 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**1:1** [...] "Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not be envious of the one who prospers, of the man who devises evil schemes" (Psalm 37:7).

**1:2** [...] and those who turned away from [...]

**1:3** This passage speaks of the Man of the Lie, who deceived many with his false words. They chose empty things and refused to listen

**1:4** to the Teacher who reveals true knowledge, who [...]

**1:5** [...] they will die by war, hunger, and disease.

**1:6** "In just a little while the wicked will vanish; though you look for where they stood, they will be gone" (Psalm 37:10).

**1:7** This speaks of all wickedness at the end of the forty years, when

**1:8** the wicked are destroyed, and not a single wicked person will be found anywhere on earth.

**1:9** "But the humble will possess the land and enjoy complete peace" (Psalm 37:11).

**1:10** This speaks of the community of God's poor, who endure their season of suffering and will be rescued

**1:11** from every trap of the Devil. After that, they will enjoy all the [...] of

**1:12** the earth, and feast on every rich delight.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of 4Q171, Col. 1. "Pesher" rendered as "this speaks of" for accessibility. "Interpreter of Knowledge" rendered as "Teacher who reveals true knowledge" for clarity. "Belial" rendered as "the Devil" to communicate the concept to modern readers. "Congregation of the Poor" becomes "community of God's poor" for readability. The forty-year period reflects Qumran eschatological expectation — a generation of testing before God's final intervention.*
